title: onprem: airgap offline bundle vendor rke2 suse-microos updates and rollback tooling
description: Context: customers on SUSE MicroOS and RKE2 reported increased drift between our vendored rke2 artifacts and upstream stable builds, causing occasional node bootstrap failures during air-gapped installs. This PR refreshes the rke2 vendor bundle for SUSE MicroOS, fixes a CVE-related containerd image tag, updates Helm values for deterministic imagePullPolicy in offline mode, and adds a first-pass rollback helper and CI job for airgap bundle sanity checks. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new offline bundle under offline-bundles/rke2-suse-microos with refreshed rke2 binaries, required container images, and updated TUF metadata; 2) Vendors rke2 and containerd manifests and patches into vendor/rke2/suse-microos to make the bundle self-contained; 3) Updates charts/redwood-private-installer/values-airgap.yaml to set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent and add configurable registryMirror entries for SUSE MicroOS installs; 4) Bumps terraform/modules/private_installer version pin and updates versions.tf to accept rke2 bundle hashes for upgrade/rollback; 5) Adds scripts/airgap/generate-bundle.sh (bundle assemble + TUF sign) and scripts/airgap/rollback.sh (idempotent rollback helper that restores previous bundle artifacts and HelmRelease values); 6) CI: adds ci/airgap-integration.yaml job that downloads the bundle artifact and runs a smoke install on our internal rke2 staging cluster; 7) Docs: docs/onprem/airgap-upgrades.md describing the upgrade and rollback procedure and caveats. Motivation: reduce customer incidents for on-prem SUSE MicroOS installs by keeping our bundles closer to upstream, and provide safe rollback tooling for fast remediation during upgrades. Testing and validation: manual air-gapped install and upgrade on internal SUSE MicroOS + rke2 staging VMs (3-node), integration smoke job in CI (job retries flaky network pulls), unit tests for bundle generator scripts. Checklist: - [x] vendor bundle generated and signed - [x] Helm values updated and smoke-tested - [x] Terraform module version bump validated with local apply - [x] rollback script tested on staging - [x] docs updated and linked to Linear ticket - [x] added CI job (non-blocking) Known limitations/risk: the bundle size increased (~400MB) and will affect artifact storage; rollback.sh assumes previous bundle still available in object storage (if not present operator intervention required). Operational notes: operators should run scripts/airgap/generate-bundle.sh in a controlled environment and push the artifact to the object's store referenced by values-airgap.yaml before starting an upgrade. Linked work items: ENG-4123 (airgap rke2 vendor refresh), ENG-4187 (rollback tooling), SUP-2291 (customer incident for node bootstrap).

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can you clarify how the rollback script selects the previous bundle? If the operator pushes a bundle with the same name it will be replaced in object storage and rollback may fail.

Priya Shah: rollback.sh records the previous bundle object's path in /var/lib/redwood/airgap_prev.json before replacing. If the previous object is missing the script exits with a clear error and guidance to contact SRE.
Aisha Patel: The TUF signing step looks good, but can we make TUF signing optional for local dev bundles?
Priya Shah: Made TUF signing gated behind the AIRGAP_SIGN env var, default on in CI. Added note in docs for local dev flow.
Samir Kapoor: CI job was flaky on network pulls, I recommend adding a short retry loop and increasing timeout for ks-pull.
release_notes: Updated SUSE MicroOS RKE2 offline bundle and added rollback tooling. Operators should regenerate and upload the new bundle before upgrading. See docs/onprem/airgap-upgrades.md for upgrade and rollback steps.
